propositions: Hand-maintained help artifacts drift from runtime parser factories post-S2b/S2c unification; gen_cli_help.py must render deterministic, parser-derived help and overview artifacts that become authoritative before operation composition.
Top-level help routes (21 intercept forms) must complete as a lexical pre-scan before operation/config/store/parser/handler resolution, serving committed generated bytes via _help_route.py pre-scan.

Generated help overview must group commands by route visibility/order, deduplicate canonical commands to single entry, annotate aliases, omit hidden/compatibility spellings, and fail --check on blank/missing factory summaries.
Parser factories in _parsers/core/ and _parsers/advanced/ must be enriched with per-argument help= and epilog text so generation renders curated prose without hand-authored usage/option tables.

Help artifact bodies must regenerate from true factory grammar (correcting hand-captured drift) while preserving byte-exact capitalized Usage: prefix and meeting determinism/completeness/stray-artifact checks.
Existing execution ladder, free-text --help later in argv, malformed syntax, unknown commands, and normal cross-boundary operation flows remain unchanged.
